#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

int count(const vector<int>& arr, int l, int r) {
    bool used[24] = {false};
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = l; i <= r; ++i) {
        int c = arr[i];
        if (!used[c]) {
            used[c] = true;
            ++cnt;
        }
    }
    return cnt;
}

int main() {
    int a, b, left, right;
    cin >> a >> b >> left >> right;
    --left;
    --right;
    int ab = a + b;
    vector<int> arr(ab * 4);

    int t = left / ab;
    left -= t * ab;
    right -= t * ab;
    t = (right - left + 1) / ab;
    if (t > 2) {
        right -= (t - 2) * ab;
    }

    int d = (a > b) ? (a - b) : 1;

    for (t = 0; t < 4; ++t) {
        for (int k = 0; k < a - d; ++k) {
            arr[ab * t + k] = k;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < d; ++k) {
            arr[ab * t + a - d + k] = (t % 2 == 0) ? (a - d + k) : (a + k);
        }
    }

    int ans = a + a;
    for (int k0 = 1; k0 <= d; ++k0) {
        for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k) {
            arr[a + k] = arr[a - k0];
        }
        for (int k1 = 1; k1 <= d; ++k1) {
            for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k) {
                arr[ab + a + k] = arr[ab + a - k1];
            }
            for (int k2 = 1; k2 <= d; ++k2) {
                for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k) {
                    arr[2 * ab + a + k] = arr[2 * ab + a - k2];
                }
                for (int k3 = 1; k3 <= d; ++k3) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k) {
                        arr[3 * ab + a + k] = arr[3 * ab + a - k3];
                    }
                    ans = min(ans, count(arr, left, right));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
